name: 76201 · Denton, TX
findings: ZIP 76201 (Denton) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76201 (Denton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76201 (Denton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
